A '''water pack''' was standard issue for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]]. It allowed the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to carry [[Water/Legends|water]] in the field.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>{{Military-stub}}
